name: PJ Western (Papa John's Russia)
note: Papa John's business in Russia. TAdviser's company profile (2026) reports the June 2026 register change: Christopher Wynne left the founders; his 75% stake in OOO 'Pi Dzhey Franchizing Rus' passed to the company itself; the remaining 25% belongs to OOO 'Pi Dzhey Eurasia', controlled by the Cypriot PJ Western Retail Investments Limited.
